Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II report request, bridge letter & trust portal access

Hi Ellen —

Really great speaking with you and Nikhil this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep the security intake moving for the pilot: 

- Can you share your SOC 2 Type II report (latest period) or a bridge letter if the Type II is not public yet?
- Please add security@medpilot.com as a user in our Trust Portal (I can send an invite) so your team can pull artifacts and find the bridge letter.
- If you prefer, we can accept a DDQ in spreadsheet form — attaching our sample intake (MedPilot_DDQ_v1.xlsx) to illustrate the fields we commonly need.

Proposed timeline: if we can get the report/bridge letter + portal access by next Friday (2028-06-09), our compliance team will do the first pass and get back with any follow-ups within 3 business days. If that timeline is tight, let me know and we’ll prioritize the bridge letter + minimal evidence set.

Attachments: none from our side in this message.

Next steps for us: Ben will provision the Trust Portal invite and Karthik will coordinate the minimal evidence list for the pilot scope (data residency and access controls).

Thanks again — excited to move forward.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Thanks Jasmine — great demo and clear next steps.

Quick answers:
- We have a SOC 2 Type II for 2027 but it’s gated behind our security portal (legal requirement). We can provide a bridge letter and grant time-limited access to the report.
- I’ve looped in Nikhil (security lead) and security@medpilot.com for provisioning. Nikhil, can you confirm who should receive the portal invite and whether Redwoods needs any specific permissions (view vs download)?

Nikhil (copied): our timeline preference is 6/10 to have the doc and portal access in place. Does that work?

Best,
